I could not verify the result from first principles. Solution 1 claims the family fails to determine N(P_4), but that argument only shows the degree sequence doesn't determine N(P_4). It does not rule out that the full family of defective polynomials encodes more than the degree sequence. Solutions 2 and 6 are unsupported guesses. Solution 3 gives 5 with explicit hedging, and I have only a vague recollection that this matches the literature on defective chromatic polynomials of trees, so my confidence is low.
